## Findings
- claim-1: For \(c=6\), accepted artifact `162283c7d25bcc9b6cf77717e180ce1c85e4bdcbe2d0dbabc186aab75e18d126` records \[ (\operatorname{rank}Q_d)_{d=4}^{8}=(1,1,2,1,1), \quad Q_d=0\ (9\le d\le32), \] with no torsion in every recorded degree.
- claim-2: Hence \[ Q\cong \mathbb Z^{1+1+2+1+1}=\mathbb Z^6. \]
- claim-3: Relative to accepted generation of \[ G_L=\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq2^4\},\qquad G_R=\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq4^2\}, \] each six-element family maps onto \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\). The accepted indexed-family Nakayama criterion therefore makes each image a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q\), so neither \(G_L\) nor \(G_R\) has a removable generator.
- claim-4: The requested \(i=j=p=2,\ c=6\) minimality corollary is established relative to the accepted computation dependency and accepted generation criterion; no parent-theorem claim is made.
## Strategy
Using accepted artifact `162283c7d25bcc9b6cf77717e180ce1c85e4bdcbe2d0dbabc186aab75e18d126`, the quotient ranks are
\[
(1,1,2,1,1)\quad(d=4,\ldots,8),
\]
with zero rank in \(d=9,\ldots,32\) and no torsion. Thus
\[
Q\cong\mathbb Z^{1+1+2+1+1}=\mathbb Z^6.
\]
Accepted generation gives surjections to \(Q\) from each six-element family
\[
G_L=\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq2^4\},\qquad
G_R=\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq4^2\}.
\]
By the accepted indexed-family Nakayama criterion, each surjection \(\mathbb Z^6\twoheadrightarrow Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\) is an isomorphism. Hence each image is a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q\); deleting a member prevents generation of \(Q\), and therefore prevents generation of \(J_{2,6}\). The requested \(i=j=p=2,c=6\) minimality corollary is established relative to these accepted dependencies.

## Gaps
None within this bounded certificate. No broader parent-theorem claim is made.
